description: Friends, we are at the Final Stretch! The push is on as we head into the final stretch of the election, but honestly, it feels like I’ve never stopped campaigning. There is always another community leader to meet, another conversation to have, another part of our state to learn about, and, most importantly, more constituents to listen to. That is what I love about this work. Being your Assemblywoman means being out in the community, hearing directly from the people I represent, and understanding what matters most to you and your families.
title: Assembly District 35 October Newsletter!
